owner_reported_bugs_this_session: FIXED+SHIPPED 34d00bd - tier-3 towers incoherent/not producing/two at once. Root cause: BUILD-phase `while` re-alignment preserved `next mod step`, so every tower entered FIGHT on an arbitrary phase offset in (0,step]; with a 30s step against a 45s fight that is 2, 1 or ZERO units by build-time luck. Now pinned to the fight edge + own 15s constant (owner's number).

FIXED+SHIPPED 34d00bd - 'my wife did two pharaohs, second waited until the first is dead'. Root cause: t9 boss releases with sourceSpawnerId=null, which routes into applySpawnCreature's one-live-per-(owner,type) latch; only voltkin+direwolf were exempt. isT9BossType now exempt too.

FIXED+SHIPPED fa89e6a - second tower of same race 'just stayed as shaped', no tower picture, 'sometimes takes a whole turn'. Root cause: igniteOneSpawnerRecipe registers the LOWEST anchor and returns, once per recipe per topology change, and ignition only runs on a frame carrying BOND_FORMED. 13 tower recipes now drain all rings, de-duped per RING (first draft de-duped per ANCHOR = 3 spawners per tier-3 ring and NINE per boss ring; caught by test).

FIXED+SHIPPED a5fc01c - 'silly goblin warrior generated from the castle'. Root cause: NOT a spawn bug. drawGoblin's green procedural puppet is the atlas-load fallback and IS the pre-veo look; ensureAtlases fetched 50.53 MiB / 18 sheets on first sync (32 MiB of it t9 bosses) so the needed sheet queued behind ~16 others. Race-keyed sheets now lazy + preloadRaceKit warms seated races at match start during BUILD.

NOT REPRODUCIBLE (verified in the running app) - 'you took away the no net. Why is there no sudoku? It doesn't work.' Clicked title->ARCADE->NONET on the dev server: full six-colour board, clock running, spirits animating, title menu correctly down, ZERO console errors. S168's modalUp fix holds. He was almost certainly on a page cached from before that fix deployed. REMEDY: hard reload.

OPEN (ART, needs regeneration) - Kraken attack pose clipped. Measured: attack.mp4 frames 0/30 are PILLARBOXED while 60/90 are not, so the packer's documented assumption ('veo's letterbox is fixed for a whole clip') is FALSE for this clip; and in the later frames the tentacles run off the edge of the 1280px source, so those pixels do not exist and no re-pack recovers them. Needs a regenerated clip on a wider composition.

OPEN (ART, needs regeneration) - Archdemon attack 'looks ridiculous / too fast'. NOT a timing mismatch: measured 12 frames x 5 tpf = exactly 60 ticks vs an attack cadence of exactly 60, identical across all six bosses. It is frame sparsity for a giant's swing.

reflexion_entries_to_archive: #empirical-refutes-plausible-criticals — the owner's loudest bug ('why is there no sudoku? it doesn't work') did NOT reproduce; clicking through the running app settled it in two minutes where code-reading would have kept hunting. Drive the app before theorising about a UI report.

#claim-addressed-not-fixed — I wrote a block comment describing STUN's boss-skill gate and never wrote the check. Only a behavioural test caught it. A comment asserting a behaviour is not the behaviour.
#test-passing-for-the-wrong-reason — the zombie-aura stun test went GREEN against an ungated aura. Every 'X does not happen' assertion needs a positive control proving X happens otherwise.

#read-the-warning-the-code-already-wrote — raceTower.ts's docblock predicted the exact bug my ignition drain shipped (one spawner per ring NODE: 3 per tier-3, 9 per boss ring). The warning was aimed at a future caller and I was that caller.
#reproduce-before-fixing — writing the ignition bug as a failing test FIRST is the only reason the 9-bosses-per-pyramid regression was caught before commit.

#owner-adjective-is-not-an-owner-number — S168 read 'similar rate as the castle' as an instruction to SHARE the castle's constant, welding two subsystems together. He then gave a number (15s). Adjectives describe; only numbers bind.

#doc-deltas-are-real — three design-note claims were wrong this session (R152's file paths, R153's hudSurfaces registration, R153's stale line numbers). Probe state before scoping from a markdown claim.
